en.headline: Consumer Council finds wide variation in sanitary pad absorbency
en.dek: One of 36 winged pads tested took 73 seconds to absorb simulated fluid, exceeding the mainland recommended standard of 60 seconds; five samples had moisture content above 10 per cent.
body: The Consumer Council tested 36 brands of disposable winged sanitary pads of different lengths and found absorption speeds ranging from a few seconds to 73 seconds. Sixteen samples fully absorbed the test fluid within 10 seconds, but one sample took 73 seconds and failed to meet the mainland recommended national standard of no more than 60 seconds.

Five samples recorded moisture content between 10.7 per cent and 12.8 per cent, above the 10 per cent level that helps maintain absorbency and reduce microbial risk after the product leaves the factory. All samples passed tests for pH, formaldehyde, transferable fluorescent substances and key pathogens, the Council said.

Nineteen samples did not list main ingredients or surface material in Chinese or English. The Council urged suppliers to improve quality control along the supply chain and to provide clearer labelling so consumers can make informed choices. It also advised buyers to check packaging for damage and store pads in a clean, cool and dry place.

zh.headline: 消委會測試衞生巾吸收速度參差 一款超國家標準
zh.dek: 36款有翼衞生巾樣本中，16款10秒內吸完試液，一款需73秒超出內地標準不多於60秒；5款水分含量高於10%。
body: 消費者委員會測試市面36款不同長度的有翼一次性衞生巾，發現吸收速度參差，介乎數秒至73秒。16款樣本於10秒或以內完全吸收模擬經血試液，但有一款需時73秒，未能符合內地推薦性國家標準不多於60秒的要求。
另有5款樣本水分含量介乎10.7%至12.8%，高於10%，反映產品出廠後未能有效保持低含水量，可能削弱吸收效能及增加微生物滋生風險。所有樣本的酸鹼值、甲醛、可遷移熒光物質及主要致病菌測試均符合相關標準。
19款樣本未有以中文或英文標示主要成分或表面材質。消委會呼籲供應商加強品質管理及供應鏈監察，並改善標示；消費者選購時應檢查包裝有否破損，並存放於清潔、陰涼及乾燥地方。
